`solve_model` still supplies `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` only converts a pandas snapshot index when it is a MultiIndex and the model is flat. If a flat multi-period model is built and the network’s snapshots are subsequently replaced with a single-period index, the callback receives that ordinary index unchanged rather than the model’s flat tuple representation. Thus the guarantee does not hold for every network and call path.
